headline: Global Central Banks Maintained Gold Purchases Through Summer
summary: Global central banks continued acquiring gold over the summer, an accumulation trend that Goldman Sachs stated could support bullion prices through the rest of the year.
why: Central bank reserves provide structural, long-term physical demand for gold as sovereign institutions diversify reserve assets away from foreign currencies.

impacts.name: Gold
impacts.why: Ongoing demand from central bank balance sheets provides a supportive floor for gold prices.
